summary: When multiple cleared cells are eligible, cleanup selection/order is not specified.

source.pattern: cleanup job with multiple cleared cells

semantics.selection: implementation may choose any eligible cell each iteration
semantics.batching: implementation may process some, all, or none in a cleanup invocation

tests.name: do not assert order
tests.input: const out=[]; const f=new FinalizationRegistry(v=>out.push(v)); let a={},b={}; f.register(a,'a'); f.register(b,'b'); a=b=null; console.log(Array.isArray(out))
tests.expected_behavior: prints true; later cleanup order must not be asserted
